female.reference_text: You begin to pull away from Mars.

male.reference_text: the words on the page came alive.

profiles.name: short-4s
profiles.text: The evening settles softly around the quiet house.

profiles.name: medium-8s
profiles.text: Beyond the window, gentle rain moves through the trees while the warm room becomes peaceful and still.

profiles.name: long-12s
profiles.text: Take a slow breath and let the noise of the day disappear. The fire glows beside you, the night is calm, and there is nowhere else you need to be.
